response.sql: WITH t AS (SELECT tr.tradekind, COUNT(*) AS cnt FROM advancedbehavior ab JOIN transactionrecord x ON ab.translink = x.transreg JOIN trader tr ON x.trdref = tr.tradereg GROUP BY tr.tradekind), s AS (SELECT tradekind, cnt, cnt * 1.0 / SUM(cnt) OVER () AS share, AVG(cnt * 1.0) OVER () AS avg_cnt FROM t) SELECT SUM(cnt) AS combined_count, AVG(share) AS avg_share, AVG(cnt - avg_cnt) AS avg_excess_over_average FROM s WHERE cnt > avg_cnt
